description: This PHP class defines EmbeddedURLForVimeo, which extends AbstractBuzzVideoURL. It contains methods and constants to extract embedded Vimeo URLs from given Vimeo video links, primarily using regex matching and validation.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForVimeo
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to convert Vimeo URLs into embed URLs, validating URL formats and extracting video IDs.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embed URL for a Vimeo video if the provided URL is valid and matches Vimeo patterns; throws an exception otherwise.
